parameters.name: BranchId
parameters.description: The branch ID that uniquely identifies a Supabase branch.

parameters.name: ProjectId
parameters.description: The ID of the Supabase project that corresponds to the primary branch.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. This parameter is required when you create a primary branch. When you create a sub-branch, this parameter inherits the region of the primary branch by default.
